visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Only a person's hands are visible, holding a large bunch of washed green leafy vegetables. They are placing the vegetables into a white ceramic pot sitting on a black induction stove. The kitchen background is bright and clean with white walls. (2) The person continues to fill the pot with the remaining green leaves from a stainless steel bowl in the background. Natural light comes from the right side of the frame. (3) A white lid is placed on the pot and pushed down firmly with both hands to ensure a tight seal. (4) Steam begins to escape from the lid. The person, wearing blue fabric oven mitts, lifts the lid to reveal the wilted, cooked vegetables. (5) A bottle of olive oil is tilted to pour oil over the greens, followed by a hand sprinkling a pinch of salt. (6) Wooden chopsticks are used to toss and mix the vegetables inside the white pot to distribute the seasoning. (7) Using a wooden spoon, the person transfers the bright green cooked vegetables onto a clean white oval plate. (8) A manual grinder is used to sprinkle black pepper over the plated dish. (9) The person picks up a portion of the vegetables with chopsticks and brings them to their mouth. Only the lower half of their face is visible as they take a bite.
